measure: One green receipt, vm-cc7cf483e850489387faf6d878bc6312 (aweb 6a460770f9, 12-CPU merak guest, every lane at once). CPU-seconds: the cumulative usage_usec of every container's cpu.stat in its memory.jsonl, attributed to a lane by name (its runner, Postgres and Redis, and the containers it started) and to a unit suite by its isolated runner and the services in that runner's network namespace. The run's shared builder (509) and static (201) are in no lane; 60 CPU-s in one unlabelled sibling (aweb-cross-reg) are attributed to none. Short-lived containers between samples are undercounted. Workers and elapsed seconds are that run's: each lane other than unit ran one process; unit's suites ran in its plan (test-server 4 xdist workers, test-naapp-lib serial, the serial suites in a pool of 3 slots). A part's workers per busy CPU is workers x elapsed / CPU-seconds (the pool's: its slot-seconds / CPU-seconds).
